requirements.title: Patch source and divergence policy configuration
requirements.rationale: Operators opt a workspace into fork authority per workspace and must be able to change it without a restart.

criteria.condition: a carry-patch sync has taken the workspace lock
criteria.action: read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY through GetVariable("workspace", slug, name) on that sync, before any fetch
criteria.contract: a variable changed between two syncs takes effect on the second sync without a hub restart

setup: a recording GetVariable stub, a recording lock and recording fetch stubs
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE initially unset
check.pseudocode: run(sync); setVar(origin); run(sync); assert calls[0:3]==[lock,getvar,getvar] ; assert originFetches==[0,1]

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE has exactly the value "origin"
criteria.action: select origin as the authority for patch branches
criteria.contract: the origin fetch stub is called once; the response has origin_fetched true

setup: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is "origin"
check.pseudocode: setVar('PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE','origin'); r=sync(); assert originFetch.count==1; assert r.origin_fetched==true

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is unset, its lookup returns an error, or its value is anything other than the exact case-sensitive string "origin" (including "hub", "Origin" and an empty string)
criteria.action: select hub as the authority and continue the sync
criteria.contract: no error is returned to the caller and the sync follows the hub path

setup: a table of PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE states: unset, lookup error, "hub", "Origin", "ORIGIN", "", "garbage"
check.pseudocode: for v in rows: r=sync(v); assert r.status==200; assert originFetch.count==0; assert r.origin_fetched==false; assert 'patches_synced' not in r

criteria.condition: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY has exactly the value "report"
criteria.action: apply the report policy to diverged patch branches
criteria.contract: the local branch is unchanged; the element has state diverged and action none

setup: origin mode with one diverged candidate patch
PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY is "report"
check.pseudocode: setVar(policy,'report'); r=sync(); assert r.patches_synced[0].state=='diverged'; assert refLocal==oldTip

criteria.condition: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY is unset, its lookup returns an error, or its value is anything other than the exact string "report"
criteria.action: apply the replace policy
criteria.contract: no error is returned to the caller

setup: origin mode with one diverged candidate patch
a table of PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY states: unset, lookup error, "replace", "Report", "", "x"
check.pseudocode: for v in rows: r=sync(v); assert r.status==200; assert r.patches_synced[0].action=='replaced'; assert r.patches_diverged==[]

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: ignore PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY
criteria.contract: both responses are identical; no patch ref and no refs/hub/replaced/* ref is written

setup: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE unset
PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY is "report" in one run and "replace" in another
a patch branch that differs from the fork
check.pseudocode: assert sync(policy='report')==sync(policy='replace'); assert refsWritten==[]

requirements.title: Origin fetch
requirements.rationale: The fork must be fetched, with stale tracking refs pruned, before patch branches can be compared with it.

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: fetch the origin remote of the trunk with refspec +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*, no tags and pruning of tracking refs whose branch no longer exists on the fork, using credentials from workspace.ResolveCloneAuth (GIT_PAT, then GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, then none), and treat an already-up-to-date result as success
criteria.contract: refs/remotes/origin/<branch> equals the fork tip for every branch; no tag is created in the trunk; the second call returns nil (already up to date)

setup: a real bare fork with branches and a tag, a trunk cloned from it with origin pointing at the fork, and no GIT_PAT set (credentials resolve to none)
a secrets store with three configurations: GIT_PAT set; only GIT_USERNAME and GIT_PASSWORD set; neither set
check.pseudocode:
FetchOrigin(ctx, trunk, auth); assert rev-parse origin/b==forkTip; assert tags(trunk)==[]; assert FetchOrigin(...)==nil
for cfg in cfgs: assert ResolveOriginAuth(store,slug)==workspace.ResolveCloneAuth(store,slug)

criteria.action: run, under the workspace lock the sync already holds, in this order: origin credential resolution, upstream fetch, origin fetch, upstream-base resolution, patch refresh, merge detection, workspace update
criteria.contract: the recorded order is lock, origin credential resolution, upstream fetch, origin fetch, upstream-base resolution, patch refresh, merge detection, workspace update; the lock is held until after the workspace update

setup: origin mode with a call-recording stub for every step and for the lock
check.pseudocode: assert calls==[lock,resolveOriginAuth,fetchUpstream,fetchOrigin,resolveBase,refresh,detect,updateWs,unlock]

criteria.condition: origin credential resolution fails
criteria.action: abort before either fetch and change nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "failed to resolve origin credentials"; upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch rows and refs are unchanged

setup: origin mode, ResolveOriginAuth returns an error
upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch rows and refs snapshotted
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert r.status==502; assert r.error=='failed to resolve origin credentials'; assert fetches==0; assert snapshot()==before

criteria.condition: the origin fetch fails after the upstream fetch succeeded
criteria.action: abort the sync leaving upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch statuses, persisted origin sync state and every refs/heads/* ref unchanged, without rolling back upstream tracking refs
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "origin fetch failed" and error_type "origin_fetch_failed"

setup: origin mode with upstream advanced, FetchOrigin returning an error
snapshot of upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, patch statuses, persisted origin sync columns and refs/heads/*
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert r.status==502; assert r.error_type=='origin_fetch_failed'; assert snapshot()==before; assert jobs==0

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: perform zero origin fetches and zero origin credential lookups
criteria.contract: FetchOrigin count is 0; ResolveOriginAuth count is 0

setup: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE unset, counting stubs for FetchOrigin and ResolveOriginAuth
check.pseudocode: sync(); assert fetchOrigin.n==0 and resolveOriginAuth.n==0

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin and SyncAPIConfig.FetchOrigin is nil
criteria.action: abort without changing state
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message "origin fetch is not configured"

setup: origin mode, SyncAPIConfig.FetchOrigin is nil
state snapshot
check.pseudocode: cfg.FetchOrigin=nil; r=sync(); assert r.status==500; assert r.error=='origin fetch is not configured'; assert snapshot()==before

criteria.condition: a branch has been deleted on the fork and an origin-mode sync fetches it
criteria.action: remove the refs/remotes/origin/<branch> tracking ref so the branch resolves as absent on the fork
criteria.contract: refs/remotes/origin/feat no longer exists; the element for feat has state missing_on_origin

setup: a real bare fork and real upstream, trunk with refs/remotes/origin/feat from an earlier fetch
feat is registered as an active patch
feat is then deleted on the fork
check.pseudocode: git(fork,'branch -D feat'); r=sync(); assert not refExists(trunk,'refs/remotes/origin/feat'); assert r.patches_synced[0].state=='missing_on_origin'

requirements.title: Per-branch outcome against the fork tip
requirements.rationale: Each registered patch branch must end a sync at the fork's tip or be reported, under one deterministic rule set.

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin and both fetches have succeeded
criteria.action: evaluate as candidates, in position order, only patches with status active, conflict or disabled, excluding patches with status merged_upstream or deleted and any patch whose name equals the integration branch
criteria.contract: patches_synced lists exactly the active, conflict and disabled branches in position order; the merged_upstream, deleted and integration-named patches have no element and their refs are untouched

setup: real fork and upstream
patches in positions 1-6 with statuses active, conflict, disabled, merged_upstream, deleted, and one active patch named like the integration branch
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert names(r.patches_synced)==['a','c','d']

criteria.condition: a candidate has no refs/remotes/origin/<branch> ref
criteria.action: leave the local branch unchanged and record state missing_on_origin with action none, leaving the patch status unchanged
criteria.contract: the element has state missing_on_origin, action none, no origin_sha, local_sha set; refs/heads/feat is unchanged; the patch status is still active; the persisted origin_sync_state is missing_on_origin and origin_sha is null

setup: real fork without branch feat, local refs/heads/feat exists, patch status active
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); e=r.patches_synced[0]; assert e.state=='missing_on_origin' and e.action=='none'; assert 'origin_sha' not in e; assert status=='active'

criteria.condition: a candidate has a fork tip and no refs/heads/<branch>
criteria.action: create refs/heads/<branch> at the fork tip with action created and state in_sync
criteria.contract: refs/heads/feat equals the fork tip; the element has action created, state in_sync, local_sha and origin_sha equal to the fork tip; the persisted state is in_sync with origin_sha set

setup: real fork with branch feat, no refs/heads/feat in the trunk, patch active
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert rev(trunk,'refs/heads/feat')==forkTip; assert e.action=='created' and e.state=='in_sync'

criteria.condition: the local tip and the fork tip resolve to the same SHA
criteria.action: write no ref and record state in_sync with action none
criteria.contract: no update-ref call is made for feat; the element has action none, state in_sync; the persisted state is in_sync

setup: real fork and trunk where refs/heads/feat equals refs/remotes/origin/feat
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert updateRefCalls==[]; assert e.action=='none' and e.state=='in_sync'

criteria.condition: the local tip is a strict ancestor of the fork tip
criteria.action: move the local branch to the fork tip with action fast_forwarded and state in_sync
criteria.contract: refs/heads/feat equals the fork tip; the element has action fast_forwarded, state in_sync, replaced_sha absent; no refs/hub/replaced/feat exists

setup: real fork where feat is two commits ahead of the hub's refs/heads/feat
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert rev(local)==forkTip; assert e.action=='fast_forwarded'; assert not refExists('refs/hub/replaced/feat')

criteria.condition: a candidate has diverged (neither tip is an ancestor of the other, or the fork tip is a strict ancestor of the local tip) and the policy is replace
criteria.action: first write the local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, overwriting any earlier backup for that branch, then move the local branch to the fork tip, recording action replaced, state in_sync and the replaced SHA
criteria.contract: refs/hub/replaced/<branch> holds the former local tip and refs/heads/<branch> holds the fork tip

setup: real fork and trunk where feat diverged (a hub commit and a different fork commit on a common base)
policy replace
real fork whose feat is behind the hub's refs/heads/feat (hub has extra commits)
check.pseudocode:
old=rev(local); r=sync(); assert rev('refs/hub/replaced/feat')==old; assert rev(local)==forkTip; assert e.replaced_sha==old
assert isAncestor(forkTip, localTip) and forkTip!=localTip; run both policies; check refs

criteria.condition: a candidate has diverged and the policy is report
criteria.action: leave the local branch unchanged and record state diverged with action none, reporting both the local and fork SHAs
criteria.contract: refs/heads/feat is unchanged; no refs/hub/replaced/feat exists; the element has state diverged, action none, local_sha and origin_sha set and different; patches_diverged equals ["feat"]; the persisted state is diverged

setup: real fork and trunk with a diverged feat
policy report
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert rev(local)==old; assert e.state=='diverged'; assert r.patches_diverged==['feat']

criteria.action: for any candidate, decide ancestry with GitRunner.IsAncestor on the SHAs resolved at the start of that candidate's step, never on branch names, and apply only the first matching rule in the order: fork branch missing, local branch missing, same commit, local strict ancestor of fork, diverged
criteria.contract: the outcome equals the first matching rule in the order fork missing, local missing, same commit, local strict ancestor, diverged; every IsAncestor call receives 40-hex SHAs and never branch names; exactly one rule's ref writes occur

setup: a real git repository with generated commit graphs and a recording GitRunner
check.pseudocode: for (fork,local,rel) in gen(): out=refresh(c); assert out==expected(first_match(rel)); assert all(isSha(a) for a in isAncestorArgs)

requirements.title: Safe ref writes
requirements.rationale: The git server does not take the workspace lock, so a push can land mid-sync and must never be overwritten silently.

criteria.action: write every patch ref and backup ref with git update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old> through GitRunner.Run, using the SHA resolved at the start of the step as expected-old and the all-zero SHA for a create, and never use checkout, reset or branch -f to move a ref
criteria.contract: each ref write is update-ref <ref> <new> <expected-old> through Run; the create uses the all-zero SHA as expected-old; the others use the tip resolved at the start of that step; no checkout, reset or branch -f call appears (apart from the HardReset of 20-REQ-4.2)

setup: a recording GitRunner over a real repo with one created, one fast-forwarded and one replaced candidate
check.pseudocode: calls=recorder.calls; assert all(c[0]=='update-ref' for c in writes); assert createCall[-1]=='0'*40; assert no c[0] in ['checkout','branch']

criteria.condition: a patch branch is moved by created, fast_forwarded or replaced and symbolic-ref -q HEAD in the trunk equals refs/heads/<branch>
criteria.action: hard-reset the trunk working tree to the new tip with GitRunner.HardReset(ctx, "HEAD")
criteria.contract: the trunk's working-tree files match the new tip

setup: real trunk whose HEAD is refs/heads/feat with a clean working tree
the fork has a new commit on feat adding a file
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert fileExists(trunk,'new.txt'); assert status(trunk)==''

criteria.condition: a ref write fails for a candidate, including a lost compare-and-swap
criteria.action: stop the refresh at that patch, keep and persist the outcomes already produced for earlier patches, still make the auto-rebuild decision for branches already moved, write neither upstream_head_sha nor last_sync_at, and leave later patches unprocessed
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message "failed to update patch branch <branch>"; the next sync sees the unmoved branches as still needing work

setup: real fork, three candidates a, b, c where a is fast-forwardable
a hub push to b lands after the ancestry check, simulated with a runner hook that advances refs/heads/b just before update-ref
AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC unset
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert r.status==500; assert r.error=='failed to update patch branch b'; assert rev(a)==forkA; assert jobs==1; assert ws.last_sync_at==before

criteria.action: count a branch moved by created, fast_forwarded or replaced as patch advanced only when its status is active or conflict, and count a moved disabled patch as refreshed and reported but not advanced
criteria.contract: the disabled run moves the ref, reports fast_forwarded and enqueues no job (rebuild_triggered false); the conflict and active runs enqueue a rebuild job

setup: real fork and upstream with upstream unchanged
a fast-forwardable patch with status disabled in one run, conflict in another, active in a third
check.pseudocode: for st in [disabled,conflict,active]: r=sync(st); assert r.patches_synced[0].action=='fast_forwarded'; assert r.rebuild_triggered==(st!='disabled')

criteria.action: for any sync where the source is hub or the policy is report, write no refs/hub/replaced/* ref and move no refs/heads/* ref of a diverged patch; for any sync where the source is hub, write no patch ref at all
criteria.contract: no refs/hub/replaced/* ref exists afterwards; every diverged branch keeps its old SHA; in hub mode the recorder saw zero update-ref calls

setup: a real repository with generated patch branches, fork branches and statuses and a recording GitRunner
check.pseudocode: for cfg in gen(): sync(cfg); assert refs('refs/hub/replaced/')==[]; if cfg.source=='hub': assert updateRefCalls==[]

requirements.title: Rebuild trigger and sync completion
requirements.rationale: A fork-side change must rebuild the integration branch exactly like an upstream advance, even when upstream did not move.

criteria.action: evaluate the "upstream HEAD has not changed" early return only after the patch refresh, so a patch-only change reaches merge detection and the rebuild enqueue
criteria.contract: merge detection runs and the patch is marked merged_upstream; patches_merged lists it; with no patch change and no upstream advance, merge detection does not run

setup: real fork and upstream, origin mode, upstream_head_sha equal to upstream HEAD
an active patch that fast-forwards and whose new tip is already contained in upstream
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert detector.calls==1; assert r.patches_merged==['feat']; r2=sync(); assert detector.calls==1

criteria.condition: upstream advanced or any patch branch counted as patch advanced
criteria.action: run merge detection over active patches using the refreshed tips; with the hub source, run it exactly when upstream advanced
criteria.contract: detection runs 0 times for the first and once for the second

setup: hub mode, a counting merge-detection stub
check.pseudocode: sync(unchanged); assert detect.n==0; sync(advanced); assert detect.n==1

criteria.condition: upstream advanced, a patch branch counted as patch advanced, or at least one patch was newly marked merged_upstream and AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is not "false"
criteria.action: enqueue a rebuild job with key slug, group slug:integration_branch and SubmittedBy set to the caller, so patch-triggered and upstream-triggered rebuilds collapse into one job
criteria.contract: rebuild_triggered true and rebuild_job_id set; rebuild_triggered false when the enqueue is deduplicated

setup: real SQLite job queue, origin mode, upstream unchanged, a fast-forwardable active patch
a caller identity
a second scenario where a rebuild job for the slug is already queued, and a third where a newly merged patch is the only change
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert job.key==slug and job.group==slug+':'+integ and job.submitted_by==caller; assert r.rebuild_triggered

criteria.condition: upstream advanced or a patch branch counted as patch advanced and AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is "false"
criteria.action: enqueue no rebuild job
criteria.contract: rebuild_triggered false

setup: AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is "false"
a patch-only change in one run and an upstream advance in another
check.pseudocode: setVar('AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC','false'); assert sync(patchOnly).rebuild_triggered==false and jobs==0

criteria.action: write last_sync_at and updated_at on every sync that completes, in hub and origin mode, whether or not anything advanced, and write upstream_head_sha only when upstream advanced
criteria.contract: last_sync_at and updated_at are newer after each sync; upstream_head_sha is unchanged after the no-change syncs and updated after the advance

setup: a workspace with an old last_sync_at
a no-change sync in hub mode and a no-change sync in origin mode, then an upstream-advance sync
check.pseudocode: for mode in [hub,origin]: sync(); assert ws.last_sync_at>old and ws.upstream_head_sha==oldSha

criteria.condition: neither upstream nor any patch changed in a sync
criteria.action: return an empty patches_merged and rebuild_triggered false
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with patches_merged [] and rebuild_triggered false

setup: upstream unchanged and, in origin mode, all candidates in_sync
check.pseudocode: r=sync(); assert r.status==200 and r.patches_merged==[] and r.rebuild_triggered==false and jobs==0

requirements.title: Sync response and CLI
requirements.rationale: Clients and CI scripts need to see which branches moved and diverged without breaking existing consumers.

criteria.action: include the boolean origin_fetched in every response, true when the fork was fetched in this sync and false otherwise, and in hub mode add no other field to the existing response
criteria.contract: origin_fetched is false in hub mode and true in origin mode; the hub response key set equals the previous key set plus origin_fetched

setup: hub mode response and origin mode response
check.pseudocode: assert keys(hubResp)==oldKeys+['origin_fetched']; assert originResp.origin_fetched==true

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: include patches_synced with one element {branch_name, action, state, local_sha, origin_sha, replaced_sha} per candidate, omitting local_sha when there is no local branch, origin_sha when the fork has no such branch, and replaced_sha unless the action is replaced, and include patches_diverged listing the branch names whose state is diverged (always [] under replace)
criteria.contract: each element has branch_name, action, state; local_sha is omitted for a missing local branch, origin_sha for a missing fork branch, replaced_sha unless action is replaced; patches_diverged lists exactly the diverged branches; under replace patches_diverged is []

setup: origin mode with candidates covering created, fast_forwarded, replaced, in_sync, diverged (report) and missing_on_origin outcomes
check.pseudocode: for e in r.patches_synced: assert ('replaced_sha' in e)==(e.action=='replaced')

criteria.action: serialise an empty patches_synced or patches_diverged as [] in origin mode, in both the CarryPatchSyncResponse JSON body and the asExtras map merged into the workspace response, and omit both fields in hub mode
criteria.contract: origin mode JSON contains "patches_synced":[] and "patches_diverged":[] (not null, not omitted) in the body and in the extras; hub mode contains neither key in either form

setup: CarryPatchSyncResponse and the asExtras map for origin mode with zero candidates and for hub mode
check.pseudocode: b=json(resp); assert b.patches_synced==[] and b.patches_diverged==[]; assert 'patches_synced' not in hub.asExtras()

criteria.condition: afc workspace sync succeeds
criteria.action: print the response JSON including origin_fetched, patches_synced and patches_diverged and exit 0, including when patches_diverged is not empty and --fail-on-diverged is absent
criteria.contract: exit code 0; existing fields are printed unchanged

setup: a stub hub returning a response with origin_fetched true, patches_synced and patches_diverged ["feat"] plus all existing fields
check.pseudocode: code,out=run(['workspace','sync',slug]); assert code==0; assert json(out).patches_diverged==['feat']

criteria.condition: afc workspace sync succeeds with --fail-on-diverged and patches_diverged is not empty
criteria.action: print the response JSON, then print a message naming the diverged branches
criteria.contract: exit code 3

setup: stub hub returning patches_diverged ["a","b"] in one run and [] in another
check.pseudocode: code,out,err=run([...,'--fail-on-diverged']); assert code==3; assert 'a' in err and 'b' in err

criteria.condition: afc workspace sync runs with --wait and --fail-on-diverged and the rebuild wait finishes
criteria.action: run the diverged check only after the rebuild wait finishes, and let a wait failure take precedence
criteria.contract: exit 1 on wait failure, otherwise exit 3 when patches_diverged is not empty; exit codes 1 and 2 keep their current meaning

setup: stub hub returning patches_diverged ["a"] and a rebuild job id
a job-status stub that succeeds in one run and fails in another
a stub returning a request error (exit 2) in a third run
check.pseudocode: assert run(waitOk)==3; assert run(waitFail)==1; assert run(usageErr)==2

requirements.title: Persisted sync state and dashboard
requirements.rationale: The patch-status dashboard must show when and how each patch last compared with the fork.

criteria.action: add the nullable columns origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at through the idempotent patchFieldDDL mechanism, without backfill, on a database that already has a patches table and across repeated initSchema runs
criteria.contract: origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at exist as nullable columns; existing rows have NULL in all three; no run returns an error

setup: a real database whose patches table predates this spec and holds rows
check.pseudocode: for i in 1..3: assert initSchema(db)==nil; cols=pragma(patches); assert {'origin_sync_state','origin_sha','origin_synced_at'}<=cols; assert allNull(rows)

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: write for each candidate patch its state, the fork tip SHA (null for missing_on_origin) and an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp from apikit.NowUTC, and clear the three columns of merged_upstream and deleted rows
criteria.contract: each candidate row has the matching origin_sync_state, origin_sha (NULL for missing_on_origin) and a timestamp parsable by apikit.ParseUTC; the merged_upstream and deleted rows have all three columns NULL

setup: real database, origin mode, candidates in states in_sync, diverged (report) and missing_on_origin
a merged_upstream row and a deleted row carrying stale origin columns
check.pseudocode: rows=select(patches); assert row(missing).origin_sha is NULL; assert parseUTC(row.origin_synced_at) ok; assert row(merged).origin_sync_state is NULL

criteria.condition: the selected source is hub
criteria.action: clear the three columns of every patch row of the workspace on each carry-patch sync
criteria.contract: all rows of the synced workspace have the three columns NULL; the other workspace's row is unchanged

setup: patch rows of the workspace with all statuses carrying origin state
a row of another workspace with origin state
check.pseudocode: sync(hub); assert all(r.origin_sync_state is NULL for r in rows(slug)); assert other.origin_sync_state=='diverged'

criteria.action: expose writing and clearing of the three columns through additive methods on PatchStore, SQLPatchStore and the test doubles, leaving existing methods unchanged
criteria.contract: the three columns are set, then cleared, in both implementations; existing PatchStore methods keep their signatures and results (the interface is still satisfied by existing callers)

setup: an SQLPatchStore on a test database and the in-memory test double
check.pseudocode: store.SetOriginSyncState(id,'in_sync',sha,ts); assert get(id).origin_sha==sha; store.ClearOriginSyncState(slug); assert get(id).origin_sha is NULL

criteria.action: expose origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at through Patch, scanPatch, patchSelectColumns and patchResponse on every patch response, omitting each when null
criteria.contract: the patch with state shows origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at; the other patch's JSON contains none of the three keys; the existing fields are unchanged

setup: a patch with origin state and a patch without
check.pseudocode: r=GET /workspaces/s/patches; assert 'origin_sha' in r[0] and 'origin_sha' not in r[1]

criteria.condition: a client requests GET /workspaces/:slug/patch-status
criteria.action: include the three fields per patch (omitted when null) and add patches_diverged and patches_missing_on_origin to the summary, always present and 0 in hub mode
criteria.contract: each patch carries the three fields, omitted when null; the summary has patches_diverged 1 and patches_missing_on_origin 1 for the origin workspace; the hub workspace summary has both counts present and equal to 0

setup: patches with origin_sync_state diverged, missing_on_origin, in_sync and null
a second workspace in hub mode
check.pseudocode: r=GET patch-status; assert r.summary.patches_diverged==1; assert hub.summary.patches_missing_on_origin==0

requirements.title: Audit events and logging
requirements.rationale: A replacement discards commits, so it needs an auditable record beyond the response.

criteria.condition: the selected source is origin
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.sync audit event per sync that completes, with metadata {origin_fetched, created[], fast_forwarded[], replaced[], diverged[], missing_on_origin[]} where each list holds branch names
criteria.contract: exactly one hub.patch.sync event is emitted using the constant from internal/audit/types.go; metadata has origin_fetched true and created, fast_forwarded, replaced, diverged, missing_on_origin lists of branch names; actor is the caller, resource_type is patch and the workspace slug is set

setup: a recording audit emitter, origin mode, candidates covering created, fast_forwarded, replaced, diverged (second run under report) and missing_on_origin
a caller credential
check.pseudocode: ev=emitter.byType(EventPatchSync); assert len(ev)==1; assert ev[0].metadata.replaced==['r']; assert ev[0].actor==caller and ev[0].resource_type=='patch'

criteria.condition: a patch branch is replaced
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.replace audit event with branch_name, replaced_sha and origin_sha, and log the replacement at info level with slug, branch and both SHAs
